introduction: Fresh from two sold-out Edinburgh Fringe runs, a twice extended UK and Ireland tour, and a sold out run at the Melbourne International Comedy Festival, award-winning and trail blazing comedian, Paul Foot, brings you his most personal, surprising and ground-breaking show ever.Filmed at London’s famous Soho Theatre, Dissolve has been critically-acclaimed and nominated for awards wherever it has gone. A show packed with laughs, intensely moving, and with an uplifting human edge that will leave you thinking about it long after the curtain falls.In the year 2022 something momentous changed for Paul, and in Dissolve he will reveal how he discovered the secret of life on the outskirts of Lancaster.* Inevitably he does get distracted by King Tutankhamun, the House of Lords, officious lollipop ladies and what Jesus might have achieved if he’d been a plumber.Funnier and more daring than I’ve ever seen him…[Has] the audience laughing so hard they’re about to leave their bodies” ★★★★★ ChortleChortle Awards Best Show nominee (2024), (ISH) Edinburgh Comedy Awards Best Show Winner (2023) and NextUp Biggest Award in Comedy nominee (2023).'A standup set that leads us into the ineffable, and dares to leave us there.' ★★★★ The Guardian*To be clear, Paul discovered the secret of life while he was located on the outskirts of Lancaster. Not the secret to living on the outskirts of Lancaster. There isn’t an answer to that.
